next_loss_mode.statement: Cinderace reaches the Active Spot via Explosiveness in only a minority of games, so Turbo Flare - the deck's only energy accelerator, attaching 3 Basic Energy to the bench - is usually unavailable and the deck must reach {M}{M}{M} through one manual attachment per turn.
next_loss_mode.why_single: it is upstream of every other weakness measured here: slow energy is what makes the evolve-turn weakness window long enough to be punished.
